“You deserve it daddy”

**Diddy** (born Sean Combs) is an American music mogul, record producer, and entrepreneur. He rose to fame in the 1990s after founding Bad Boy Records, where he helped shape hip-hop culture by launching and managing major artists like The Notorious B.I.G., Mary J. Blige, and Faith Evans. Over the decades, he built a massive business empire spanning music, fashion, and beverages, making him one of the most prominent figures in entertainment.

**Meek Mill** (born Robert Rihmeek Williams) is an American rapper from Philadelphia who gained national attention in the early 2010s after signing with Rick Ross’s Maybach Music Group. Known for his high-energy delivery, he has released several successful albums and singles, including hits like *Tupac Back* and *Dreams and Nightmares*. Beyond music, he has been a vocal advocate for criminal justice reform following his own high-profile legal battles over probation violations.

The two figures have frequently crossed paths in the music industry as collaborators and long-time social acquaintances.
